pl183.details: San-X Rilakkuma Korilakkuma jumbo plush, approximately 87 cm (34 in) tall, with the red button on the chest. Pre-owned and in clean condition according to the photos: no visible stains, tears or damage. It is kept in a clear plastic bag, and the hang tag is not included. A small brand tab is sewn onto the side seam. The photos show the front, the sides, the back, the tail, the feet and the arms. Please see the photos for the exact condition.
